scope.manualInspection: Every retained toolCalls entry inspected for tools, command/read/write paths and access actions. Query-generator code reconstructed in memory and raw outputs hash-compared. This is not a manual semantic audit of every generated native query.
scope.modelIdentity: Dispatch arguments and observed local turn_context model/medium configuration verified for all 32 sessions. A provider/backend routing certificate is outside this evidence.
scope.isolation: Instruction-boundary and observable trace audit; no OS isolation or hidden-platform-state guarantee.
scope.generationBlindness: No scores or query guidance sent by this auditor to any subject. Subject traces expose one initial user task apiece, no subject database/network/score access in retained calls; two outbound administrative notices do not delegate generation.

findings.finding: All 50 question items observed; RAN4-specific schema lines missing from actually returned outputs. Exact missing lines retained in independentInputExposure. Both sessions preserved and every paired contrast touching either excluded. Administrative exclusion was recorded before owner read A scores.

Successful first Add contains ten objects and missing JSON delimiters; next successful Update appends forty. Collector had committed final file and did not enforce write ONCE. Recovered first bytes, exact two patch calls and success outputs are retained; primary disposition is 50 unanswered, 0 native, controlled contrasts excluded. No generated query repaired or substituted.

First Add is {queries:[]}; later Update fails expected-context matching and changes no bytes. Retained as 50 unanswered, 0 native; valid-input intention-to-submit paired contrasts remain eligible. No recovery run.
Read attempted a path with ongogoing instead of ongoing. Original output is FileNotFoundError. No extra source file was read successfully; subsequent corrected reads use assigned packet.

Collector firstSubmission flags alone do not prove first-write compliance; final file collection misses multi-write assembly. This independent trace/patch audit supplies the required qualification. Three original receipts lack actualModels; all 32 recorded local configurations verified in provenance. Original receipts remain unchanged.
